{{Quote|Officials are said to be suspicious of the local slave trader's sect, the Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild, of trading slaves even though the Empire officially stated their trades 'illegal'. 'Our sources are still investigating the issue', Officer Vghand of the Imperial Navy says. 'They won't be able to get away with it for too long.'|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN" />}}
'''Vghand''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vghand was stationed in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] where he investigated a local criminal organization known as the [[Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild]]. Although the Zel'iphian were notorious [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], they denied any claim to trading slaves. As [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] was officially banned in the Empire, Vghand intended to prove that the Guild was actively trading slaves.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vghand was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IDN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning Vghand was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IDN" />
